title.narrative: Stop the Spread of COVID-19, Uganda

description.narrative: 1. Train 1,000 VHTs on COVID-19 prevention and Home-based Care (HBC) management within communities at the sub-county level. 2. Train 500 frontline health workers (including laboratory staff) on COVID-19 prevention and case management, including detection, timely reporting, rapid testing, and management of COVID cases. 3. Procure and distribute PPE and medical supplies to 500 FHWs and 1,000 CHWs and assorted disinfectants and hand washing equipment for 100 health facilities. 4. Deploy digital training to 14,000 VHTs. 5. Provide a 3-month stipend to 1,000 VHTs involved in the emergency response.

To support the MOH to Stop the Spread of COVID-19 in Uganda, Amref has designed an intervention that leverages its existing institutional partnerships and infrastructure in Uganda to train 15,000 VHTs and 500 FHWs. This will support VHTs and FHWs to reduce community transmissions of COVID-19 in 20 districts across the Acholi and West Nile regions.
